import bpy, os, math, base64, tempfile
from mathutils import Vector
scene=bpy.context.scene
elev=bpy.data.collections.get('01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4')
core=bpy.data.collections.get('E | NUCLEO VERTICAL 4 ELEVADORES | blockout v1')
upper=bpy.data.collections.get('F | ESTACAO CIDADE ALTA INTERIOR | blockout v1')
terrain=bpy.data.objects.get('WORLD | TERRENO MASTER | blockout')
tower=next((o for o in elev.objects if 'torre documental' in o.name.lower()),None)
hall=next((o for o in elev.objects if 'hall piso terreo marcador' in o.name.lower()),None)
if not all((elev,core,upper,tower,hall)): raise RuntimeError('estrutura QA incompleta')
# salvar estados temporarios
old_engine=scene.render.engine; old_cam=scene.camera; old_res=(scene.render.resolution_x,scene.render.resolution_y,scene.render.resolution_percentage); oldfmt=scene.render.image_settings.file_format
old_hidden={o:o.hide_render for o in scene.objects}
cam_data=bpy.data.cameras.new('QA_CUTAWAY_CAM'); cam=bpy.data.objects.new('QA_CUTAWAY_CAM',cam_data); scene.collection.objects.link(cam)
try:
    # esconder terreno e casca externa; manter passadico/hall para contexto
    if terrain: terrain.hide_render=True
    for o in elev.objects:
        keep=('passadico' in o.name.lower() or 'hall piso terreo marcador' in o.name.lower())
        o.hide_render=not keep
    for o in core.objects: o.hide_render=False
    for o in upper.objects: o.hide_render=False
    theta=tower.rotation_euler.z; ex=Vector((math.cos(theta),math.sin(theta),0)); ey=Vector((-math.sin(theta),math.cos(theta),0))
    center=(tower.location+hall.location)/2; center.z=36.0
    cam.location=center-ey*95+Vector((0,0,4)); cam.rotation_euler=(center-cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler(); cam_data.type='ORTHO'; cam_data.ortho_scale=88; cam_data.clip_end=500
    scene.camera=cam; scene.render.engine='BLENDER_WORKBENCH'; scene.render.resolution_x=320; scene.render.resolution_y=240; scene.render.resolution_percentage=100; scene.render.image_settings.file_format='JPEG'; scene.render.image_settings.color_mode='RGB'; scene.render.image_settings.quality=45
    p=os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(),'qa_elevador_cutaway.jpg'); scene.render.filepath=p; bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
    b64=base64.b64encode(open(p,'rb').read()).decode('ascii')
    print('CUTAWAY_JPEG_B64='+b64)
    print('QA_CUTAWAY_OK')
finally:
    for o,v in old_hidden.items():
        if o.name in bpy.data.objects: o.hide_render=v
    scene.render.engine=old_engine; scene.camera=old_cam; scene.render.resolution_x,scene.render.resolution_y,scene.render.resolution_percentage=old_res; scene.render.image_settings.file_format=oldfmt
    bpy.data.objects.remove(cam,do_unlink=True); bpy.data.cameras.remove(cam_data)
